integration-rot

ver · v0.4.4 star · 131 tests lic · MIT plat · CLI + REST + MCP

Dependencies rot silently. This autopilot watches yours: it finds every use of a dying API, drafts the migration, and proves the fix with generated contract tests before anything is kept.

▶ Read the docs GitHub ↗ ✦ Join the waitlist

Examples

Real things integration-rot does — drawn from the docs, the demos and the repos.

EXAMPLE 1

Stripe Charges becomes PaymentIntents

The scanner finds client.charges.create calls, the fixer drafts the PaymentIntents rewrite, and contract tests prove it before the fix is kept.

EXAMPLE 2

SendGrid v2 mail.send, retired

The v2 JSON endpoint pattern is detected and rewritten for the v3 API — including the endpoint URL itself.

EXAMPLE 3

Proof, not promises

Each fix is applied to a temp copy and exercised by generated contract tests. Green keeps it; red reverts it, automatically.

EXAMPLE 4

The hosted waitlist

A managed version is coming — monitoring, PRs and all. Join the waitlist from the docs page.

Details

What ships with it.

  • Deprecation DB covering 76 SDK packages
  • Deterministic planner: scan, draft, test, keep-or-revert
  • Contract tests generated per fix, run hermetically
  • CLI, REST API and MCP server interfaces
  • Zero runtime dependencies
